title: Patrol check

time.label: Time
time.needStart: Tap "Start" when you arrive at the store.
time.endFirst: Please tap "End" first. Then you can send.
time.overReview: Over 15 minutes: a manager will check the time.

smile.5: Eye contact and a smile in all 4 scenes: entry, taking the meal ticket, serving, leaving
smile.name: ① Smile
smile.maskNote: If staff wear masks, the smile score is 1 point.

voice.4: Greetings are said, but only by the person in charge (not everyone)
voice.5: Everyone says "Irasshai" within 3 s of entry, "Maido" when taking the meal ticket, "Omatase shimashita" when serving, and everyone says "Ōkini" on leaving; audible outside
voice.name: ② Greeting voice

grooming.name: ③ Grooming
grooming.desc: Clean uniform / head towel worn / hair covered / short nails / no accessories

clean.1: 4 or more dirty, or a bad smell
clean.name: ④ Cleanliness
clean.desc: Counter / tables (condiments, chopsticks, napkins) / floor / ticket machine & entrance / bins

quality.1: Very different from the sample, foreign object, lukewarm, etc.
quality.name: ⑤ Serving quality (surprise check)
quality.desc: Noodles as in the sample photo / soup up to the line / toppings placed as in the sample / bowl rim clean

lowerHint: If unsure between two scores, choose the lower one and write why.

goodPoints.label: Good points
goodPoints.placeholder: e.g. loud, clear greeting (write names too)

improvements.label: To improve / advice given
improvements.placeholder: e.g. soup was below the line

fourItems: No ⑤: judged on 4 items, 20 points
editable: You can edit for 24 hours after sending.
staffOnShiftHint: Choose each staff member on shift. If nobody is chosen, it is recorded as "everyone".
photoHint: Take at least 1 photo of the store during the patrol. Photos with staff are even better (do not film customers’ faces).
photoAfterStart: You can take photos after tapping "Start".

cancel.title: Cancel this patrol?
cancel.body: The start time, scores, comments and photos will all be deleted.
